claim: Lockstep copies of the prohibited-address scanner must match including docstrings. Perpetua-Tools implements it in scripts/review/repo_hygiene_core.py. orama-system keeps a monolith scripts/review/repo_hygiene.py with no core module, and its tests exempt that monolith path.

decisions.notes: A docstring-only drift in orama-system _parsed_address_token was realigned in 66d9348ee98c7196d92554d87cb72d4fdf128db2 so scanner text matches Perpetua-Tools. Tests patch repo_hygiene_core in Perpetua-Tools and the monolith module in orama-system.
